headline: Strong Pipeline Drives Growth Outlook

highlights: Revenue grew 3.3% QoQ and 9.7% YoY in CC terms, reflecting broad-based growth across verticals and geographies.

Management highlighted healthy deal ramp-ups, improving revenue conversion, and a record-high pipeline; it also upgraded FY27 revenue growth guidance to the low double-digit range from high-single- digit to low double-digit earlier.  EBIT margin stood at 14.8%, flat QoQ and down by 50bps YoY, missing Consensus and NBIE estimates by 40bps and 20bps, respectively.

Margins were impacted by amortisation costs related to the TAP acquisition; higher onsite mix in initial phases of AI-led engagements; and continued investments in Tria, IP development, and delivery capabilities.
Management reiterated its preference to prioritise growth over margin optimisation, while maintaining FY27 EBIT margin guidance of 14.75–15.75%.
valuation: Valuation and outlook: Mphasis delivered a strong sequential CC revenue growth in Q2FY27, supported by healthy deal conversion, ramp-up of large deal wins, and broad-based demand across key verticals.
We reiterate our ‘HOLD’ rating on Mphasis, the valuation is based on an unchanged multiple of 18x on blended EPS of Rs134, translating into a TP of Rs2,412.
